description: Parse Set-Cookie headers and report their attributes. Names cookies with no Secure, no HttpOnly or no SameSite; SameSite=None without Secure, which browsers reject so the cookie is never set at all; an unrecognised SameSite value, where the default applies instead; a lifetime beyond a stated maximum; an unexpected Domain; and a Domain attribute at all, which widens a cookie to every subdomain. No cookie value is returned, only its length. Pay 120000 atomic USDC on Base via exact x402. MCP does not pay; it provides a challenge handoff.

contract.description: The rules to apply. An unknown property here is refused rather than ignored.

expected_domain.description: The host the cookies should be scoped to.

forbid_same_site_none.description: Defaults to false, since a deliberate cross-site cookie is legitimate.

set_cookie.description: Set-Cookie header values, without the header name. A single string is also accepted.
example: session=abc123; Path=/; HttpOnly; Secure; SameSite=Lax; Max-Age=86400
legacy=1; Path=/; Secure; HttpOnly; SameSite=Lax; Max-Age=63072000

name: cookie_attribute_audit

complete.description: Whether everything supplied was examined. False means part of it was not, which is a different problem from something that is wrong.

conformant.description: True only when every cookie parsed and every declared rule held.

cookies.description: Per cookie: name, value length, Secure, HttpOnly, SameSite, Domain, Path, Max-Age, Expires and whether it is session scoped. Never the value.

finding_count.description: The true total, even when the listing is bounded.

passed.description: The same verdict under the name shared across the caller-supplied families.

request_id.description: Delivery request identifier; also returned in x-foundry-request-id.

title: Cookie Attribute Audit
